basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Kalyani Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 35 Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Kalyani (AIIMS Kalyani), Academic Section has announced 35 vacancies for Post Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) posts for the January 2027 session, with course durations of 12 months (except Vitreo Retinal Surgery which is 2 years). Qualifications vary by post, as specified in the official notification. The notified pay is as applicable to the first year Academic Senior Resident under the residency scheme of Govt of India. Candidates can apply online through the Google Form link provided in the notification and pay the application fee through RTGS/NEFT by 5:00 P

application_fee.details: Candidates must pay the prescribed application fee through RTGS/NEFT in favor of “AIIMS KALYANI INTERNAL RESOURCES ACCOUNT” (Account No: 41277688529, State Bank of India, IFS Code: SBIN0063963, Branch: AIIMS Kalyani Branch). Application fee once remitted is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Kalyani Post Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and fees is 09.11.2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available for the January 2027 session?
faq.answer: There are a total of 35 vacancies, which include 14 Government sponsored seats and 21 Open seats (Unreserved).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for Unreserved and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for Unreserved and OBC candidates is Rs. 1000/-.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years, with relaxations as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. When and where will the selection interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held in Hybrid mode from 26.11.2026 to 27.11.2026 in the Ground Floor Academic Block, AIIMS Kalyani, starting at 9 AM onwards.
